description: This file contains test fixture code for the PlaybackService component, including mock setup, test initialization, and utility functions for testing the PlaybackService class in a media playback system.

classes.name: PlaybackServiceTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up and executing unit tests on the PlaybackService component.

methods.name: sharedMemoryBufferWillBeInitialized
methods.description: Sets up expectation for creating a shared memory buffer mock.

methods.name: sharedMemoryBufferWillReturnFdAndSize
methods.description: Sets up expectations for retrieving file descriptor and size from the shared memory buffer mock.

methods.name: createPlaybackServiceShouldSuccess
methods.description: Initializes the PlaybackService instance with mocked dependencies, expecting successful creation.

methods.name: triggerSwitchToActive
methods.description: Calls the switchToActive method on the PlaybackService instance.

methods.name: triggerSwitchToInactive
methods.description: Calls the switchToInactive method on the PlaybackService instance.

methods.name: triggerSetMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of playbacks in the PlaybackService.

methods.name: triggerSetMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of Web Audio players in the PlaybackService.

methods.name: triggerSetClientDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the client display name in the PlaybackService.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of shared memory file descriptor and size.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryShouldFail
methods.description: Tests failure to retrieve shared memory information.

methods.name: getShmBufferShouldSucceed
methods.description: Verifies that the shared memory buffer can be retrieved successfully.

methods.name: getShmBufferShouldFail
methods.description: Verifies behavior when shared memory buffer retrieval fails.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybacksShouldSucceed
methods.description: Checks that the maximum number of playbacks is correctly reported.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayersShouldSucceed
methods.description: Checks that the maximum number of Web Audio players is correctly reported.

methods.name: clientDisplayNameShouldBeSet
methods.description: Verifies that the client display name environment variable is correctly used.
